Other treatments have in- cluded the application of a thick layer of yellow soft paraffin or application of yellow mercuric oxide 1% eye ointment twice daily for about 7 or 8 days or a single ap- plication of fluorescein eye drops. Body louse infestations in the developed world are mainly seen in homeless individuals, and often respond to the pro- vision of opportunities for simple hygiene. Clothing and bed linen of persons with body lice should be washed at high temperature or dry cleaned or treated with insecti- cides. There is some evidence that oral ivermectin may be effective in killing body lice. Table 1. Classification of pesticides.
